rules.collision_switches: last 3 actual FRESH switches union active path origin; deduplicate by FRESH ID
rules.raw: nearest B projection + original remaining polyline; no B-to-projection connector
rules.corrected: entire actually ACCEPTED GF path, as requested (not suffix)
rules.execution: corrected path: actual GF application to next path application; otherwise original FRESH interval
rules.path_vs_footprint: executed minimum minus active polyline minimum; negative means actual motion came closer
rules.counterfactual: one protected GraphV4 initialization/solve per collision switch; original sample, dispatch B, previous command/prior unchanged; full oracle SDF/corridor, no online latency gate or rollout
